description: Source code implementing thumbstick input handling for UWP game controllers, including dead zone processing and reading thumbstick states.

methods.name: ApplyLinearDeadZone
methods.description: Applies a linear dead zone to a float input value, scaling it into the -1 to 1 range.

methods.name: ApplyStickDeadZone
methods.description: Applies dead zone processing to thumbstick X and Y axes.

methods.name: ReadThumbStick
methods.description: Reads the current thumbstick positions from a Gamepad object, applying dead zone adjustments.

methods.name: GetGamepadThumbSticks
methods.description: Retrieves thumbstick positions from all connected gamepads and stores them in a provided vector.
